fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después de la fecha en que piensa salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At Bulgarian border control you may be asked for proof of accommodation, travel insurance, a return or onward ticket and enough money.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo búlgaro puede que le pidan comprobante de alojamiento, seguro de viaje, billete de vuelta o de continuación y dinero suficiente.
entry.quote:
At Bulgarian border control, you may also need to:

- show proof of your accommodation, for example, a hotel booking confirmation or proof of address for a second home

- show proof of your travel insurance

- show a return or onward ticket

- prove that you have enough money for your stay

entry.en: Visitors entering the Schengen area for a short stay may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo under the EES.
entry.es: Los visitantes de corta estancia en el espacio Schengen pueden tener que registrar datos biométricos, como huellas y una foto, en el sistema EES.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared, or the money could be seized when you leave.
entry.es: Hay que declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por 10.000 euros o más; si no, el dinero podría ser confiscado al salir.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: Meat, milk and products containing them cannot be taken into EU countries, with some exceptions such as baby milk and baby food.
entry.es: No se pueden llevar carne, leche ni productos que los contengan a países de la UE, salvo excepciones como la leche en polvo y la comida para bebés.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

safety.en: Tourists are targeted by thieves and pickpockets in Sunny Beach and other larger cities and resorts.
safety.es: Los turistas son objetivo de ladrones y carteristas en Sunny Beach y otras ciudades y complejos turísticos grandes.
safety.quote: Tourists are targeted by thieves and pickpockets in Sunny Beach and other larger cities and resorts.

safety.en: Some tourists have been overcharged, by hundreds of pounds, in so-called gentlemen's clubs in Sofia and some resorts.
safety.es: Algunos turistas han sido cobrados de más, por cientos de libras, en los llamados clubes de caballeros de Sofía y de algunos centros turísticos.
safety.quote: Some tourists have been the victims of overcharging in so-called ‘gentlemen’s clubs’ in Sofia and in some resorts including Bansko, Borovets and Sunny Beach. Overcharging can amount to hundreds of pounds.

safety.en: There is an increase in unlicensed taxis from Sofia airport overcharging passengers.
safety.es: Han aumentado los taxis sin licencia del aeropuerto de Sofía que cobran de más a los pasajeros.
safety.quote: There has been an increase in unlicensed taxis from Sofia airport overcharging passengers.

safety.en: Many parts of Bulgaria flood after heavy rains, and flooding has caused deaths.
safety.es: Muchas zonas de Bulgaria se inundan tras fuertes lluvias, y las inundaciones han causado muertes.
safety.quote: Many parts of Bulgaria flood following heavy rains. Flooding is usually localised but can occasionally be widespread and has caused deaths.

safety.en: In summer and early autumn Bulgaria is on regular alert for wildfires, which can spread quickly in forests and fields.
safety.es: En verano y principios de otoño Bulgaria está en alerta regular por incendios forestales, que pueden propagarse rápido en bosques y campos.
safety.quote: In summer and early autumn, Bulgaria is on a regular alert for wildfires. There is danger of large-scale and quick-spreading fires in forests and fields.

safety.en: Covering your face with a niqab, burka or similar in public places is illegal in Bulgaria and may bring a fine.
safety.es: Cubrirse el rostro con niqab, burka o similar en lugares públicos es ilegal en Bulgaria y puede conllevar una multa.
safety.quote: Covering your face with a niqab, burka or similar head covering in public places is illegal in Bulgaria and police could give you a fine.

health.en: Stray dogs are common and can be dangerous, and rabies and other animal-borne diseases are present, so animal bites need immediate medical advice.
health.es: Los perros callejeros son comunes y pueden ser peligrosos; hay rabia y otras enfermedades animales, por lo que una mordedura exige atención médica inmediata.
health.quote: Take any animal bites seriously and seek immediate medical advice as rabies and other animal-borne diseases are present in Bulgaria.

health.en: Most Bulgarian hospitals are basic and old-fashioned, and hospital staff rarely speak English.
health.es: La mayoría de los hospitales búlgaros son básicos y anticuados, y el personal rara vez habla inglés.
health.quote: Most Bulgarian hospitals are basic and old-fashioned compared to those in the UK. Standards of medical care are generally good, but specialised equipment and treatment may not be available. Hospital staff rarely speak English.

health.en: Private clinics and hospitals are generally well-equipped, but tourists have sometimes been overcharged in resort clinics, so agree a price in advance.
health.es: Las clínicas y hospitales privados suelen estar bien equipados, pero a veces se ha cobrado de más a turistas en clínicas de centros turísticos, por lo que conviene acordar el precio antes.
health.quote: Foreign tourists have sometimes been overcharged in private clinics in tourist resorts.

health.en: Tap water is described as safe in the mountain regions but best avoided in North Bulgaria and near the seaside.
health.es: Se indica que el agua del grifo es segura en las montañas, pero conviene evitarla en el norte de Bulgaria y cerca de la costa.
health.quote: it is best to avoid drinking tap water in North Bulgaria and in the regions near the seaside

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Bulgaria.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Bulgaria.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Bulgaria.

help.en: The emergency number in Bulgaria for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Bulgaria para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

help.en: If 112 does not connect, dial 166 for police, 150 for ambulance and 160 for the fire department.
help.es: Si no se conecta con el 112, marque el 166 para la policía, el 150 para ambulancia y el 160 para bomberos.
help.quote: If you can not connect to 112, dial 166 for police, 150 for ambulance and 160 for the fire department.

getting_in.en: Bulgaria has four international airports, in Sofia, Varna, Bourgas and Plovdiv.
getting_in.es: Bulgaria tiene cuatro aeropuertos internacionales: Sofía, Varna, Burgas y Plovdiv.
getting_in.quote: There are four international airports in Bulgaria, located in the cities of Sofia (SOF IATA), Varna (VAR IATA), Bourgas (BOJ IATA), and Plovdiv (PDV IATA)

getting_in.en: Most traditional flag carriers fly only to Sofia, while charter flights from Western Europe often go to Varna or Bourgas.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de las aerolíneas tradicionales vuelan solo a Sofía, mientras que los vuelos chárter desde Europa occidental suelen ir a Varna o Burgas.
getting_in.quote: most traditional flag carriers (like Lufthansa, British Airways, Turkish Airlines) fly only to Sofia International Airport

getting_in.en: Ryanair flies to Sofia, Burgas, Varna and Plovdiv.
getting_in.es: Ryanair vuela a Sofía, Burgas, Varna y Plovdiv.
getting_in.quote: Ryanair flies to Sofia, Burgas, Varna and Plovdiv.

getting_in.en: The direct train from Thessaloniki to Sofia no longer operates as of 2026 due to railway modernisation.
getting_in.es: El tren directo de Tesalónica a Sofía ya no circula en 2026 por la modernización de las vías.
getting_in.quote: as of 2026 it no longer operates due to ongoing modernisation of the railway lines

getting_in.en: The direct train between Belgrade and Sofia no longer runs as of 2026, so a bus from Belgrade or Niš is suggested.
getting_in.es: El tren directo entre Belgrado y Sofía ya no circula en 2026, por lo que se sugiere un autobús desde Belgrado o Niš.
getting_in.quote: as of 2026 it no longer runs due to several lines being rebuilt

getting_in.en: A sleeper train runs between Istanbul Halkali and Sofia via Edirne and Plovdiv, with passport control at Kapikule on the border.
getting_in.es: Un tren cama une Estambul Halkali y Sofía vía Edirne y Plovdiv, con control de pasaportes en Kapikule, en la frontera.
getting_in.quote: a sleeper train departs Istanbul Halkali at 21:40, running via Edirne, Kapikule on the border where you get out for passport control, and Plovdiv, to reach Sofia by 09:40

getting_around.en: The fastest way to travel around the country is by bus, and buses frequently connect all the larger cities.
getting_around.es: La forma más rápida de recorrer el país es el autobús, que conecta con frecuencia todas las ciudades grandes.
getting_around.quote: The fastest way to travel around the country is by bus. Buses frequently connect all the larger cities.

getting_around.en: Most bus station agents and drivers outside the Black Sea and Sofia speak only Bulgarian, and destinations are written in Cyrillic.
getting_around.es: Fuera del Mar Negro y Sofía, la mayoría de los empleados de estaciones y conductores solo hablan búlgaro y los destinos están escritos en cirílico.
getting_around.quote: Most bus station agents (except at the Black Sea and in Sofia) as well as the drivers will not speak or understand any languages except Bulgarian (and, if you are lucky, Russian) and the destinations will be written exclusively in Cyrillic.

getting_around.en: A one-way bus ticket from Sofia to the Black Sea costs 12 to 15 euros.
getting_around.es: Un billete de autobús de ida de Sofía al Mar Negro cuesta de 12 a 15 euros.
getting_around.quote: A one way ticket to the Black Sea from Sofia costs €12-15.

getting_around.en: Buses depart on time and do not wait for late passengers.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses salen a la hora y no esperan a los pasajeros que llegan tarde.
getting_around.quote: Buses depart on time and don't wait for late passengers.

getting_around.en: The train is convenient and inexpensive but usually slower than the bus, and the only passenger operator is Bulgarian State Railways.
getting_around.es: El tren es cómodo y barato, pero suele ser más lento que el autobús, y el único operador de pasajeros es los Ferrocarriles Estatales de Bulgaria.
getting_around.quote: Using the train is a convenient, inexpensive and great way to travel the country, even if it's usually slower than the bus.

getting_around.en: Bulgarian trains have no dining cars or trolley service, so bring water and snacks on long trips.
getting_around.es: Los trenes búlgaros no tienen vagón restaurante ni carrito de servicio, así que conviene llevar agua y comida en viajes largos.
getting_around.quote: There are also no dining cars or trolley service, so make sure that you have enough water and snacks on long trips.

money.en: Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026, replacing the lev.
money.es: Bulgaria adoptó el euro el 1 de enero de 2026, en sustitución del lev.
money.quote: Bulgaria adopted the euro as its national currency on 1 January 2026, replacing the lev

money.en: Bulgaria remains largely a cash economy in rural areas, but cards are generally accepted in major cities.
money.es: Bulgaria sigue siendo una economía mayormente de efectivo en zonas rurales, pero en las grandes ciudades suelen aceptarse tarjetas.
money.quote: Bulgaria remains a largely cash economy in rural areas; but in major cities, credit and debit cards are generally accepted.

money.en: Money should never be exchanged on the street, and it is much safer to exchange at a bank.
money.es: Nunca se debe cambiar dinero en la calle, y es mucho más seguro hacerlo en un banco.
money.quote: Never exchange money out on the street.

money.en: Bulgaria has an extensive ATM network making cash easy to obtain in all major cities and resorts.
money.es: Bulgaria tiene una extensa red de cajeros que facilita obtener efectivo en las principales ciudades y centros turísticos.
money.quote: Bulgaria has an extensive ATM network, making it relatively easy to obtain cash in all major cities and resorts.

money.en: Tips are not added to the bill, and 5-10% is suggested if you like, though many restaurants make tipping unnecessary.
money.es: Las propinas no se añaden a la cuenta; se sugiere un 5-10% si se desea, aunque en muchos restaurantes no es necesario.
money.quote: Tips are not added to the bill, so give 5-10% if you like. However, many restaurants are run by their staff, so it is not necessary to tip.

etiquette.en: Nodding means no and shaking your head means yes in Bulgaria, the reverse of most countries.
etiquette.es: En Bulgaria asentir con la cabeza significa no y negar significa sí, al revés que en la mayoría de los países.
etiquette.quote: The meaning of nodding or shaking your head is the reverse of most countries: nodding means 'No' and shaking your head means 'Yes'.

etiquette.en: Visitors are advised not to call the Bulgarian alphabet the Russian alphabet.
etiquette.es: Se aconseja no llamar al alfabeto búlgaro alfabeto ruso.
etiquette.quote: Do not refer to the Bulgarian alphabet as the "Russian alphabet".

etiquette.en: In smaller towns, especially in the Rhodopes, people may invite you for lunch, dinner or even to sleep over.
etiquette.es: En pueblos pequeños, sobre todo en los Ródope, la gente puede invitar a almorzar, cenar o incluso a dormir.
etiquette.quote: In smaller towns, especially in the Rhodopes, people may invite you for lunch, dinner or even to sleep over.

etiquette.en: Bulgaria is described as a conservative country where LGBTQ+ individuals may need to be discreet.
etiquette.es: Se describe a Bulgaria como un país conservador donde las personas LGBTQ+ pueden tener que ser discretas.
etiquette.quote: Bulgaria is a conservative country, so LGBTQ+ individuals may need to be discreet as assaults sometimes occur.

etiquette.en: Bulgarians do not really do chit chat, so talking to someone at a shop till may get odd looks or be ignored.
etiquette.es: Los búlgaros no son de charla trivial, así que hablar con alguien en una caja puede causar miradas extrañas o ser ignorado.
etiquette.quote: Bulgarians don't really do chit chat, so trying to make conversation with someone at a till in a shop will probably result in odd looks

connectivity.en: Bulgaria has three mobile networks, A1, Yettel and Vivacom, all at least 4G.
connectivity.es: Bulgaria tiene tres redes móviles, A1, Yettel y Vivacom, todas con al menos 4G.
connectivity.quote: There are three mobile phone networks (A1, Yettel, and Vivacom), all using the GSM standard on at least 4G level.

connectivity.en: Mobile service has almost full national coverage, with minor exceptions in the highest and most remote mountains.
connectivity.es: El servicio móvil cubre casi todo el país, con pocas excepciones en las montañas más altas y remotas.
connectivity.quote: Mobile service has almost full national coverage, with minor exceptions in the highest and the most remote parts of the mountains.

connectivity.en: Free WiFi is often available in public places such as libraries and gas stations, and many pubs and hotels have it too.
connectivity.es: A menudo hay WiFi gratuito en lugares públicos como bibliotecas y gasolineras, y muchos bares y hoteles también lo ofrecen.
connectivity.quote: Free WiFi access is often available in public places such as libraries and in gas stations. Many pubs and hotels will also have free WiFi.
